Where to start learning computer graphics?

Computer graphics is a fairly broad field of study and can include many different subfields. 
Can I ask you to tell us a little more about what you would like to do and what you would like to get as a result, in order to orient you more precisely?
I want to learn 3D modeling to make models for computer games, but for now I’m not even good at drawing.

If you're just starting to learn computer graphics and 3D modeling, there are a few basic steps you can take to get you started.

1. Study the basic principles of drawing.

To get started, you'll need to learn the basics of drawing and composition principles so you know how to create images that look attractive. Not only will drawing help you improve your visual thinking skills, but it will also give you the ability to better understand light, shadows, and shapes. You can start with simple drawing exercises using pencils or digital drawing programs.

2. Study of 2D and 3D graphics.

To create 3D models, you will need to learn the basics of working with 2D and 3D graphics. You can start by mastering drawing programs such as Adobe Photoshop or GIMP, which will allow you to create 2D images. You can then move on to learning 3D graphics and basic modeling principles. Some of the popular 3D modeling programs include Blender, Autodesk Maya, 3DS Max and ZBrush.

3. Study of programming and game engines.

Once you've learned the basics of drawing and 3D modeling, you may need to learn programming and game engines to create computer games. To get started, you can choose a simple game engine like Unity or Unreal Engine and learn the basics. This will allow you to create games and animations using your drawing and modeling skills.

4. Practice and creativity.

Finally, one of the most important aspects of learning computer graphics and 3D modeling is practice and creativity. Try creating your own designs, experimenting with different tools and programs, and looking for inspiration in the work of other artists and designers. The more you practice, the more you will learn about the process of creating computer graphics and 3D modeling, and the more skills you will gain.

How can I improve playing the piano?

There are many ways to improve at the piano, here are some suggestions that may help you:

1. Practice Regularly: Regular practice is key to improving at any skill, including playing the piano. Try to play at least a little every day.

2. Learn basic chords: Learning basic chords is a great way to start playing songs right away. Practice major and minor chords, and try combining them to create chord progressions.

3. Play simple songs through basic sheet music: Start with simple songs and make sure to follow the sheet music carefully. Over time, you can increase the complexity of the songs.

4. Practice fingering: Proper fingering is essential to playing the piano effectively. Practice fingering exercises to develop solid technique.

5. Learn the positions of the notes on the keyboard: Knowing the positions of the notes on the keyboard will allow you to play faster and with greater precision.

6. Practice reading notes: The ability to read sheet music is essential for playing the piano. Practice reading notes every day to improve your skills.

7. Learn scales and arpeggios: Scales and arpeggios are valuable tools to improve your technique and develop a finer ear for music. Take time to practice them regularly.
